easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Coveted Jewel from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Coveted Jewel from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
